common: Create a polished grounded fantasy character production concept sheet, landscape 3:2 composition, quiet warm-grey parchment-neutral studio background, restrained earthy painted material colors and detailed believable human anatomy, natural small heads about 7.5-8 heads tall. Smooth carefully sculpted 3D-looking illustration with real nose/brow/lid/jaw volumes, separate sculpted hair locks, no flat faceting or toy/chibi exaggeration. This is concept artwork for a shared adjustable adult human family. Exactly SIX full-body ADULT figures in a clean two-row, three-column grid, all fully visible with feet. Top row three ADULT body silhouettes wearing only opaque pale linen modesty tunics to mid-thigh and opaque short underlayers, bare feet, arms relaxed slightly away from torso. All have identical simple swept-back dark hair, medium warm skin, neutral expressions. Top left compact FULLER feminine-framed adult, 1.60m, broad hips and soft abdomen, shorter thicker neck. Top middle midpoint 1.75m, medium build and intermediate frame, moderate neck. Top right 1.90m tall masculine-framed adult, lean athletic, broad shoulders and longer neck. The middle body must visibly interpolate the endpoints. All six on corresponding common baseline within their row, same orthographic camera and pixels-per-metre, taller heads reach higher on page. Bottom row repeats EXACTLY the same three people in EXACTLY the same order and proportions wearing fitted versions of the SAME removable outfit design. Its neckline/hem, number of pieces, closures, color, belt and ornament identity must match across all three bodies, with sleeves/trousers/waist adapted to wearer. Bottom poses the same neutral A-rest view as above so silhouette fit can be compared. Full lower-body practical coverage. No weapons, no environment, no portrait insets, no extra figures, no clutter, no fake gameplay screenshots, no nudity. Material surfaces matte, coherent light from upper-left. Sharp readable construction seams and openings, recognizable faces. Add small understated exact header title and top-of-column labels '1.60 m', '1.75 m', '1.90 m'. The sheet is a design proposal, never a claimed 3D fit validation.

candidates.title: A — Wayfarer
candidates.suffix: Header exact text 'A — WAYFARER'. Outfit design is a practical grounded low-fantasy traveller: off-white collarless linen shirt with open short slit neck and long sleeves, a separate muted moss-green sleeveless fitted vest ending at upper hips with three plain leather tab closures, separate narrow dark-brown waist belt, charcoal wool trousers, simple brown calf-high leather boots. One small plain dull bronze pendant hangs at the collar. No armor plates, cape, hood or pouches. The short vest permits easy view of pelvis and leg silhouette. Show linen thickness and slightly worn leather. The SAME vest cut and closures appear on all three. Subtle cloth ease across shoulders and full waist. Head looks realistically sculptable.

candidates.title: B — Quilted watch
candidates.suffix: Header exact text 'B — QUILTED WATCH'. Outfit design is a grounded low-fantasy town guard's light field outfit: off-white linen long-sleeve shirt, separate warm rust-red quilted short-sleeve jack with subdued vertical quilting and a split short skirt reaching to upper thigh, narrow brown belt, slate-grey trousers and brown practical mid-calf boots. A separate SMALL rigid darkened-steel upper breastplate over the jack with two leather shoulder straps and simple horizontal overlapping lower edge. No pauldrons, weapons, helmet, cloak or oversized armor. One plain bronze pendant at neckline. Same jack paneling, plate silhouette and fastening identity on all three wearers with adjusted fit. Metal is solid smoothly formed matte dark steel, never bends as fabric. Distinct strong red torso silhouette; plate restraint preserves realistic body shape.

candidates.title: C — Fieldworker
candidates.suffix: Header exact text 'C — FIELDWORKER'. Outfit design is a grounded low-fantasy working traveller: separate muted ochre wrap-front long-sleeve work tunic with diagonal overlap secured by two flat side ties, upper-thigh hem with practical short side splits, separate faded dark-teal narrow sleeveless leather shoulder yoke over chest and upper back held by small dark leather tabs, charcoal-brown separate trousers, a narrow dark brown waist belt, sturdy brown ankle-high boots. Small plain bronze pendant at collar. No corset, breastplate, ornate decorations, cloak, bags, tools or weapons. This tunic has room for both a soft abdomen and lean chest and remains the SAME construction in all three sizes. Keep wrap overlap modest and opaque, convincing understated worn linen/leather. More organic diagonal torso construction than a symmetrical vest or quilted armor.

reconstruction: Concatenate common and suffix verbatim for each submitted prompt. All three calls are complete.
